caption: The drawing contains three vertically oriented rectangular panels, each bordered by a solid black line. Inside each panel, there are large yellow and orange floral motifs with prominent dark edges and subtle white highlights. The flowers are attached to twisted, vine-like stems colored in shades of brown and orange. Small white buds are visible among the larger flowers in the second and third panels. The background of each rectangle is a gradient of deep red, fading slightly toward the center, enhancing the contrast with the yellow flowers. The entire drawing is set against a plain, beige background.
title: Painted Glass
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
